title: Acceptance tests for a knowledge-driven Corpus Pane
plainLanguage: A bigger library is not automatically a better library. We should prove that the knowledge actually helps on unseen videos and later on real doll assembly.
purpose: Define measurable evidence that each new knowledge layer is worth keeping.

rules.statement: Test on clips not used to author the reference material.
Measure reference retrieval usefulness, correction count/time, repeated error rate, view-classification clarity, and unresolved-gap detection.
Verify that adding external references never overwrites manual pins, owner-approved scopes, or source media.
For poser parts, test joint alignment, seam coverage, layer order, silhouette, articulation envelope, and identity preservation.
A failed or ambiguous test remains recorded; do not promote the feature by hiding difficult cases.

implementation.currentSupport: Existing Corpus Pane already has workflow/integrity tests and a five-clip seed library.
implementation.futureWork: Add knowledge-benefit A/B tests and real doll assembly tests.
